svg.aria-label: Ludo Delux from source code to a running game. Build and release: the source code lives on GitHub. A push sends it three ways. Vercel builds and deploys the web version. GitHub Actions builds the Android app. GitHub Actions builds the iOS app on a Mac, an Apple certificate signs it, and it goes to TestFlight and App Store review. Play together: each device trades a short handshake through the mailbox on Vercel, which stores the room list in Neon. Then every device links directly to every other, and the host sends the board to all. A Cloudflare relay carries a link only when no direct path exists.
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: From source code to a game on every platform
live in a minute or two
builds the iOS app on a Mac
the mailbox who is in the room
Realtime: every device links to every other. The host sends the board to all.
A Cloudflare relay carries a link only when no direct path exists.
